convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom 'Leading' indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position sizing and order management logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp alignment
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check before OnTick logic proceeds

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: short crossover closes long, long crossover closes short

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input with MarginMode selector (LOT vs risk-based); exact logic in TradeAlgorithms.mqh library

custom_logic_notes: Signal is evaluated on bar[SignalBar] (default bar 1 = previous closed bar). Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] with Ma1[0]<Ma2[0] means: on the previous bar Ma1 was above Ma2, and on the signal bar Ma1 is below Ma2 — this is a crossover where Ma1 crosses below Ma2, triggering SELL_Open and BUY_Close. Conversely Ma1[1]<Ma2[1] with Ma1[0]>Ma2[0] triggers BUY_Open and SELL_Close. The crossover detection uses a 2-bar lookback (bar indices SignalBar and SignalBar-1 relative to handle). UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to open functions likely as expiry or timestamp gating. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans gate whether each direction's open/close is enabled by user input.
python_conversion_notes: The 'Leading' custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python — its buffer logic (two lines driven by Alpha1=0.25 and Alpha2=0.33) is unknown and must be reverse-engineered from the indicator source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory — all must be reimplemented. The MMMode enum (LOT vs other) controls position sizing mode and must be decoded from the .mqh. CIsNewBar class must be replicated for new-bar detection. Signal timestamp alignment (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime = lastbar_date + PeriodSeconds) likely serves as order expiry — verify in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are large values suggesting the EA is designed for 5-digit brokers (100.0 pips SL / 200.0 pips TP); verify digit-adjustment logic in the library.
